title: fix: refresh verified provider costs
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## Pricing changes

All values below are Pollinations recorded provider cost in **USD per 1M tokens**. OpenRouter rows include the account 5.5% credit-purchase fee exactly once.

| Canonical model | Exact route | Input | Cached input | Output |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `openai/gpt-4o-mini` | OpenRouter Azure/OpenAI | $0.150000 → $0.158250 | $0.075000 → $0.079125 | $0.600000 → $0.633000 |
| `qwen/qwen3.8-27b` | OpenRouter Chutes FP8 primary | $0.337600 → $0.253200 | $0.033760 → $0.025320 | $2.637500 → $2.321000 |
| `qwen/qwen3.8-27b` | OpenRouter AkashML FP8 fallback | $0.337600* → $0.263750 | $0.033760* → $0.052750 | $2.637500* → $2.321000 |
| `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash` | Direct DeepInfra fallback | $0.080000 → $0.060000 | $0.016000 → $0.015000 | $0.180000 → $0.180000 |
| `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | OpenRouter DeepInfra FP8 fallback | $0.211000 → $0.147700 | $0.006330 → $0.004431 | $0.633000 → $0.443100 |
| `nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning` | OpenRouter CoreWeave BF16 fallback | $0.105500 → $0.073850 | $0.052750 → $0.042200 | $0.263750 → $0.211000 |

\* Akash previously inherited the Chutes primary sheet. It now has its exact route-specific sheet. Qwen image/video input follows each route's published generic input rate.

## Unchanged

Canonical names, aliases, providers, `paidOnly`, `priceMultiplier`, capabilities, and fallback topology are unchanged.

## Verification

- Rechecked exact live provider catalogs and OpenRouter endpoint records on 2026-09-21.
- Local E2E billing matched GPT-4o Mini and Qwen Chutes.
- Direct probes matched AkashML, DeepInfra V4/V4.1, and CoreWeave.
- Focused pricing/fallback tests, snapshot, Gen typecheck, and all CI checks pass.

Draft note: published cache rates were verified; the paid long-prefix cache-hit experiment was not run.

gist.headline: The price tags got pollenated
gist.blurb: The hive rechecked its provider receipts and replaced a few inherited price tags with the real ones. Qwen’s AkashML route now has its own sheet, because apparently even fallback routes deserve correct arithmetic.
gist.summary: Refreshed recorded per-million-token provider costs for GPT-4o Mini, Qwen 3.8-27B on Chutes and AkashML, DeepSeek V4/V4.1 Flash, and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, including a route-specific AkashML Qwen price sheet instead of the inherited Chutes rates.
gist.impact: Billing now reflects verified live route costs, with lower recorded rates across several Qwen, DeepSeek, and Nemotron paths and accurate cache/input/output pricing for each provider fallback.
